FileExportAllowed.title: FileExportAllowed
FileExportAllowed.description: Allow file exports, including filter files.

UserPreferencesSaveAllowed.title: UserPreferencesSaveAllowed
UserPreferencesSaveAllowed.description: Allow saving personal preferences and filters.

PolicyVersion.description: Policy contract version. Only version 1 is supported.

AllowedExportFormats.description: Allowed values. An empty list disables export.

DefaultExportFormat.description: Recommended default; a permitted personal choice takes precedence.

ForcedExportFormat.description: Required value; must be in the allowed list.

AllowedCompressionLevels.description: Allowed values. An empty list disables export.

DefaultCompression.description: Recommended default; a permitted personal choice takes precedence.

ForcedCompression.description: Required value; must be in the allowed list.

RedactionMode.description: Force redaction on or off, or allow user control. Required filters imply force-on.

RequiredBuiltinFilters.description: Required built-in filters, using their original matching semantics.

ManagedRedactionRules.description: Required custom filters. Maximum 400 combined managed and personal rules; enabled must be true. Runtime validates limits and Regex.

enabled.description: Must be true; enforced by the extension.

PreviewAllowed.title: PreviewAllowed
PreviewAllowed.description: Allow opening Preview & edit, including selection previews.

FilterSettingsAllowed.title: FilterSettingsAllowed
FilterSettingsAllowed.description: Allow opening Customize filter settings, including direct navigation.

DisabledBuiltinFilters.description: Built-in filter IDs that must be off. Must not overlap RequiredBuiltinFilters. Unlisted IDs keep their current behavior.
